mapper.sql: id, collection, asset_key, name_vi, name_en, name_ja, name_ko, description, tags::text AS tags, image_url, source, source_url, license_note, status, version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND (asset_key ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR name_en ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR COALESCE(name_vi, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR tags::text ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_library (id, collection, asset_key, name_vi, name_en, name_ja, name_ko, description, tags, image_url, source, source_url, license_note, status, version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{collection}, #{assetKey}, #{nameVi}, #{nameEn}, #{nameJa}, #{nameKo}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{tags}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{imageUrl}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, #{licenseNote}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_library SET asset_key = #{assetKey}, name_vi = #{nameVi}, name_en = #{nameEn}, name_ja = #{nameJa}, name_ko = #{nameKo}, description = #{description}, tags = COALESCE(#{tags}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), image_url = #{imageUrl}, source = #{source}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, license_note = #{licenseNote}, status = #{status}, version = #{version}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM asset_library WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT FROM asset_library
ORDER BY name_en ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
